aeon.closure_not_loaded_is: modules in the static import closure of tool_path and the conversion tool at `revision` that the recorded run and the conversion never loaded (they are imported inside functions the run did not call: the audit trace above). Not pinned: a change there cannot move this output unless a pinned file starts calling it, and that change moves a pinned blob.
aeon.data_not_opened_is: committed files a loaded module names (an os.path.join of string literals) that the audit trace saw no process of the recorded run or the conversion open. Not pinned: the output cannot depend on a file nothing opened.

inputs_by_value.why: READ by the tools (the audit trace saw every recorded run open it) and pinned by the VALUES of the constants they read, not by its blob (ROADMAP row 234, replacing row 219's declared exclusion): a blob pin reds on every unrelated constants edit (37 aeon commits in the 30 days to 2026-09-28; days with a currency red over those 30 days: 9 before row 219, 19 under the whole-file pin, 16 with the file excluded, 16 (only 2 of the 37 commits moved a pinned value, 77cf6a71 and 2a727b29, and each also moved a file pinned by blob) under this pin). Read here by: clip_manifest.py (geometry_constants: SECTION_SIZE, MAX_ACT_SECTIONS; player_clearance_px: PLAYER_Y_RADIUS; _const: PLAYER_X_RADIUS); ojz_strip_gen.py (module level: ART_POOL_PAGE_TILES); clip_manifest.py jump_reach_px (PHYS_GRAVITY, PHYS_JUMP_FORCE and KNUX_JUMP_FORCE, over constants.emp THEN games/sonic4/player/knuckles.emp, so a constants.emp definition of KNUX_JUMP_FORCE would win). NOT READ WHOLESALE: fg_working_set.ConstantSource scans every `const` line but resolves only the names asked for, each by evaluating its right-hand side over the names it mentions, FIRST DEFINITION WINNING; layer_lines takes the first `^pub const NAME = literal`. So each output depends on the file only through the resolved values below, and a value moves whenever its own line, a line it depends on, or an earlier definition of the name moves. The values are aeon's own parsers' answers at `revision` (ConstantSource.get, layer_lines.engine_constants); the provenance row recomputes them with test/support/emp-constants.ts's transcription of those parsers, and the currency row recomputes them at aeon origin/master. names_not_read: constants a loaded module names that this run never reads.
